## Business reason

An organization administrator wants to tell everyone, or a few named people, something in the app: an outage window, a policy change. Today there is no place in Setup to do it; the only way is to write an automation flow.

## What to build

- In Setup, a "Send in-app message" action that opens a dialog: recipients as a multi-user picker or an "everyone in this organization" switch; title, body, severity and an optional link.
- Shown only to organization administrators. The dialog calls the server action #32445 PR 2 adds; the server door judges the gate and the recipients, the dialog only reflects them.
- On success, say how many people it went to; on refusal, show the server's reason.

## Acceptance

- An organization administrator sends to two picked users and to everyone; both arrive in each recipient's inbox.
- A plain member does not see the action.
- The dialog uses the action's declared form; no second copy of the field rules in the client.
